'''January 2001 St. Cloud tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in St. Cloud, Minnesota in January 2001. [[Michael Raveling]] won it. It is known from Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1648">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-st-cloud-2001d1648/ st-cloud-2001], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 21 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-st-cloud-2001d1648/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' January 2001
* '''Site:''' St. Cloud, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 30
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Raveling]]
